title: Unauthorized location sharing
description: Child's GPS coordinates are transmitted without explicit consent or awareness of how they will be used.

title: Unauthorized data access
description: Child's device may transmit location data without the child's full understanding or consent.

title: Data interception during transmission
description: GPS coordinates transmitted over the network could be intercepted by third parties.

title: Unauthorized data storage
description: GPS data may be stored indefinitely or shared with third parties without the child's consent.

title: Unauthorized data processing
description: GPS data may be used for purposes beyond the child's expectations, such as tracking or profiling.

title: Uncertainty about consent
description: There is uncertainty whether the child truly understands and consents to the transmission of their GPS coordinates.

title: Location data can be used to deduce sensitive personal information
description: Location pings collected by the mobile app backend can be used to deduce sensitive information about the user such as home address, workplace, daily routines, and private locations, even if not explicitly shared.
assumptions: Assumes location data is collected and transmitted to the backend

title: Location data can be used to identify and track individuals
description: Location data enables identification of specific individuals and continuous tracking of their movements over time, creating detailed movement profiles.
assumptions: Assumes location data is unique to individual users

title: Users may not be adequately notified about location data collection
description: Users may not be fully informed about the extent of location data collection, its purpose, or how it will be used, violating transparency requirements.
assumptions: Assumes standard mobile app practices may not provide comprehensive location privacy notices

title: Location history can be used to deduce sensitive patterns and behaviors
description: Stored location history enables deduction of user patterns, habits, and sensitive locations over time, including home, workplace, and private locations.
assumptions: Assumes location history is stored and potentially analyzed

title: Location data in storage can be used to identify individuals
description: Location data stored in the history store can be used to identify and profile specific individuals based on their movement patterns and locations.
assumptions: Assumes location data is stored and potentially accessible

title: Location data may not be properly destroyed when no longer needed
description: Location history data may not have appropriate retention and deletion policies, leading to indefinite storage of sensitive personal location information.
assumptions: Assumes data retention policies may not be properly implemented

title: Location data sharing
description: Location pings are shared with geofencing engine, potentially exposing user movement patterns and travel routes

title: Location data transmission
description: Location data is transmitted in transit, potentially vulnerable to interception by unauthorized parties

title: Location data storage
description: Location data is stored and processed by geofencing engine, potentially exposing user movement patterns and enabling profiling

title: Data retention
description: Location data may be retained longer than necessary for geofencing purposes, increasing privacy risk

title: Unintended data use
description: Location data may be used for purposes beyond geofencing (e.g., marketing, profiling, analytics) without user consent

title: Identification through location
description: Location data could be used to identify individuals or link them to specific times/places, enabling re-identification

title: Identification through location
description: Location data could be used to identify individuals or link them to specific times/places, enabling re-identification and profiling

title: Location Data Collection
description: The Family Account Store collects and stores location-based zone definitions (home, school, friend's house) which contain sensitive personal location information about family members and their daily activities.
assumptions: Zone definitions are stored in the Family Account Store and may contain precise or approximate location data.

title: Unauthorized Data Access
description: The Family Account Store may be accessed by unauthorized parties who could read the zone definitions and infer sensitive information about family members' locations and routines.
assumptions: The Family Account Store is not adequately protected against unauthorized access.

title: Unintended Data Usage
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may use the zone definitions in ways not intended by the family, such as tracking family members' movements or inferring sensitive information about their daily activities.
assumptions: The geofencing engine processes zone data for alerting purposes but may have additional uses.

title: Location Data Processing
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine processes location data from zone definitions, which may be used to track or monitor family members' movements and activities.
assumptions: The geofencing engine actively processes and analyzes location data from the zone definitions.

title: Location Data in Transit
description: Location-based zone definitions are transmitted in transit between the Family Account Store and Geofencing & Alert Engine, potentially exposing sensitive location information to network interception.
assumptions: Zone definitions are transmitted over a network between DS2 and P2.

title: Location data sharing without consent
description: The geofencing engine shares location-based arrival/departure notifications with the parent entity, potentially revealing individuals' movement patterns and zone access without explicit consent.
assumptions: Assumes the geofencing engine has access to location data and shares it with the parent entity.

title: Individual identification through location data
description: The arrival/departure notifications could be used to identify and track specific individuals based on their movement patterns and zone access.
assumptions: Assumes the parent entity can link notifications to specific individuals.

title: Data interception during transmission
description: Location-based notifications transmitted from the geofencing engine to the parent could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during data flow.
assumptions: Assumes the data flow may not be fully encrypted or protected.

title: Parent entity disclosure of location data
description: The parent entity may disclose the received location-based notifications to third parties or use them for purposes beyond the original intent.
assumptions: Assumes the parent entity has discretion over how to use or share the received data.

title: Parent entity identification of individuals
description: The parent entity could use the location-based notifications to identify and track specific individuals based on their movement patterns.
assumptions: Assumes the parent entity can link notifications to specific individuals.

title: Excessive Data Collection
description: Parent may share more personal data about the child (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) than is strictly necessary for account registration and profile creation.
assumptions: Assumes the parent is aware of what data is being collected and may not be fully informed about data minimization requirements.

title: Potential Lawfulness Issues
description: Parent may be sharing sensitive child data without proper legal basis or consent mechanisms in place.
assumptions: Assumes the parent may not fully understand or comply with data protection laws regarding minor's data.

title: Data Integrity During Transmission
description: Personal data (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) could be intercepted, modified, or corrupted during transmission from parent to mobile app backend.
assumptions: Assumes data is transmitted over network without guaranteed encryption or integrity protection.

title: Unintended Data Disclosure During Transit
description: Data in transit could be exposed to unauthorized parties through network interception or compromised communication channels.
assumptions: Assumes data may be transmitted over potentially insecure networks without adequate protection.

title: Purpose Limitation Violation
description: Mobile app backend may use the collected child data (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) for purposes beyond the stated registration and profile creation.
assumptions: Assumes the backend may have broader data usage policies than initially disclosed to the parent.

title: Data Tampering After Receipt
description: Stored child data could be modified or corrupted by unauthorized parties after being received by the mobile app backend.
assumptions: Assumes data storage may not have adequate access controls and integrity mechanisms.

title: Unauthorized Data Disclosure
description: Child profile data (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) may be disclosed to unauthorized third parties or accessed by unauthorized personnel.
assumptions: Assumes the backend may have insufficient access controls or data sharing agreements.

title: Regulatory Non-Compliance
description: Processing of child data may not comply with applicable data protection regulations (e.g., COPPA, GDPR-K) regarding consent, data minimization, and security requirements.
assumptions: Assumes the mobile app backend may not have proper compliance frameworks for handling minor's data.

title: Potential lack of lawful basis for collecting child profile data
description: The mobile app backend may collect child profile data without adequate legal basis or proper consent from guardians, potentially violating data protection laws.
assumptions: Assumes child profile data includes sensitive information about minors

title: Excessive data collection of geofence zone information
description: The backend may collect more geofence zone data than necessary for the stated purpose, potentially violating data minimization principles.
assumptions: Assumes geofence data is collected continuously or more frequently than needed

title: Insufficient notice to users about data storage practices
description: Users may not be adequately informed about what account, child profile, and geofence data is being stored and how it will be used.
assumptions: Assumes privacy policy may not clearly explain data storage practices

title: Potential for discriminatory use of stored profile data
description: The stored child profile and geofence data could potentially be used to discriminate against users or their children based on location patterns or profile information.
assumptions: Assumes data could be accessed by third parties or used for profiling

title: Unfair data storage practices affecting user rights
description: The storage of comprehensive account, child profile, and geofence data may create unfair situations where users cannot easily control or delete their data.
assumptions: Assumes data retention policies may be unclear or overly restrictive

title: Potential non-compliance with data protection regulations
description: The data store may not be fully compliant with applicable data protection laws regarding storage, access, and retention of sensitive user and child data.
assumptions: Assumes jurisdiction-specific regulations may not be fully implemented

title: Parent shares child's location data
description: Parent requests to view child's location, which may be used to track the child's movements and movements patterns
assumptions: Parent has access to child's location data and shares it with the mobile app backend

title: Parent shares child's identification data
description: Parent requests to view child's location, which may be used to identify the child and link to other personal information
assumptions: Parent has access to child's identification data and shares it with the mobile app backend

title: Location data intercepted in transit
description: Location data transmitted from parent to mobile app backend could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transmission
assumptions: Data is transmitted over a network that may not be fully secured

title: Location meta-data links parties
description: Meta-data about the parties (parent-child relationship) in the location data could be used to link them and infer relationships
assumptions: Meta-data is included in the data flow

title: Backend stores location data longer than necessary
description: Mobile app backend may store child's location data longer than necessary for the parent's request
assumptions: Backend has storage capabilities and may retain data beyond the immediate request

title: Backend discloses location data to unauthorized parties
description: Mobile app backend may disclose child's location data to unauthorized parties or third parties
assumptions: Backend has access to child's location data and may share it with other entities

title: Backend uses location data beyond parent's request
description: Mobile app backend may use child's location data for purposes beyond the parent's request, such as profiling or advertising
assumptions: Backend has access to child's location data and may use it for other purposes

title: Disclosure of Location History Data
description: Location history data stored in DS1 may be disclosed to unauthorized parties during the retrieval process, potentially exposing sensitive movement patterns and personal location information.
assumptions: Location history contains sensitive personal information about user movements and locations

title: Data in Transit Disclosure
description: Location history data transmitted from DS1 to P1 may be intercepted during transit, potentially exposing sensitive personal location information to unauthorized parties.
assumptions: Data transmission may not be fully encrypted or may traverse untrusted networks

title: Improper Processing of Location Data
description: The mobile app backend (P1) may process or store location history data in ways that exceed the original purpose, potentially leading to unauthorized access or misuse of sensitive location information.
assumptions: P1 may retain location data beyond the immediate service requirement or share it with third parties

title: Parent disclosing child's location to secondary guardian
description: Parent shares child's location data with a secondary guardian (e.g., grandparent, relative) without explicit consent from the child or without verifying the guardian's identity and relationship to the child.
assumptions: Parent may not fully understand the privacy implications of sharing location data with a third party.

title: Location data interception during transit
description: Child's location data transmitted from parent to mobile app backend could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during data transmission, potentially exposing sensitive location information.
assumptions: Data transmission may occur over public or semi-public networks without adequate encryption.

title: Mobile app backend storing child's location data
description: Mobile app backend may store child's location data without proper retention policies, potentially exposing sensitive location information to unauthorized access or data breaches.
assumptions: Backend may retain location data longer than necessary or without adequate access controls.

title: Unnecessary Location Sharing
description: The mobile app backend shares live location data with a secondary guardian without ensuring it is the minimum necessary for the intended purpose, potentially exposing more location data than required.
assumptions: Assumes the secondary guardian relationship is legitimate and consented to.

title: Location-Based Identification
description: The act of sharing live location data enables identification of the child through their movement patterns and location history, which could be used to track or profile the child.
assumptions: Assumes the secondary guardian has legitimate access rights.

title: Unauthorized Disclosure of Location
description: The secondary guardian may disclose the child's location data to unauthorized third parties or use it for purposes beyond the intended guardian relationship.
assumptions: Assumes the guardian has access to the data and may not have proper security controls.

title: Unintended Use of Location Data
description: The secondary guardian may use the location data for purposes other than the intended guardian relationship, such as commercial purposes or sharing with other parties.
assumptions: Assumes the guardian may have access to the data and may not have proper controls.

title: Location Data in Transit
description: Live location data transmitted over the network may be intercepted by unauthorized parties, potentially exposing the child's real-time location to third parties.
assumptions: Assumes the data flow may not be fully encrypted or may traverse untrusted networks.

title: Aggregated data can be linked to individuals
description: Even though data is aggregated, correlation with other data sources or metadata could enable re-identification of users.

title: Analytics data can identify users
description: Usage patterns and engagement metrics may contain sufficient information to identify individual users, even if not explicitly.

title: Data may be disclosed to third parties
description: The advertising/analytics partner may share the received data with other third parties without user consent.

title: Data used for unintended purposes
description: The advertising partner may use the data for purposes beyond the original agreement with the app developer.

title: Data flow metadata can link users
description: Meta-data about the data flow (timing, volume, frequency) could be used to link or identify users.

title: Location Sharing
description: Child's current location is shared with parent, potentially revealing sensitive personal information about the child's whereabouts and movements.
assumptions: Child voluntarily shares location data through manual check-in/SOS mechanism

title: Identification through Location
description: Location data can be used to identify and track the child, potentially enabling surveillance or profiling.
assumptions: Location data is unique enough to identify the child

title: Unintended Disclosure in Transit
description: Location data transmitted between child and parent could be intercepted by unauthorized third parties during data flow.
assumptions: Data transmission may not be fully encrypted or may be intercepted

title: Identification through Meta-data
description: Meta-data about the parties (child and parent) in the communication could be used to link or identify them.
assumptions: Communication metadata is captured and analyzed

title: Location Tracking Capability
description: Parent receives location data that enables tracking of child's movements, potentially creating surveillance concerns.
assumptions: Parent has access to and can use the location data

title: Unintended Disclosure at Destination
description: Parent may share or disclose the child's location data to unauthorized third parties.
assumptions: Parent has discretion to share data with others
